purpose: Integration schema to receive Ismet's durable external checkpoint archival. Local presence + SHA are already tracked (results/checkpoint_inventory.json, checkpoint_manifest_consolidated.json). External-archive fields stay 'pending' until Ismet provides verifiable evidence. Nothing is marked externally archived here.

status_vocabulary.checkpoint_hash_known: SHA256 of the local checkpoint is recorded
status_vocabulary.checkpoint_locally_archived: copied into a local durable archive location
status_vocabulary.checkpoint_externally_archived: uploaded to an external durable store (Zenodo/S3/etc.)
status_vocabulary.archive_sha: SHA256 of the externally archived object

records.note: Ismet tag day8-checkpoint-archive-v1 observed on origin; treat as PENDING external evidence until a verifiable location + SHA are provided.

integration_rule: Flip checkpoint_externally_archived to true and populate external_archive_location + archive_sha ONLY when Ismet provides a resolvable location whose downloaded object SHA matches archive_sha; then set archive_verification_status=verified.
